description.value: Cactus Club Cafe is an upscale casual dining chain with a chef-driven international menu served in a stylish, energetic space just blocks from Willowbrook Shopping Centre in Langley. The restaurant features a full lounge, patio seating, and private dining rooms, making it one of the more polished sit-down options along this stretch of the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists looking for a substantial meal, happy hour, or late-night stop will find a reliable full-service restaurant with delivery and pickup also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Cactus Club Cafe chain restaurant at 101–6070 200th Street, Langley, with takeout and delivery explicitly listed as restaurant features. No evidence of bike-specific amenities (racks, parking, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) appears anywhere in the website content; all such fields default to null per instructions. The OSM record carried no phone number, but the website provides (778) 906-5773, which is adopted as the current value.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; (778) 906-5773 sourced from website only.
None of the WWC required criteria are confirmed from website content — no mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms.
Chain restaurant with centralised head office in Vancouver; local staff responsiveness to cyclist-specific requests is unknown.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active full-service restaurant suitable as a meal stop for touring cyclists, but none of the three WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum accreditation requirements before including.
